scripts.deploy: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:hosting: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.cap:sync: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npx cap open ios

scripts.ios:targets: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npx cap run ios --list
